//scripts: The upstream scripts (pnpm -w …, mtsc, vitest) belong to the monorepo this package was vendored out of and cannot run here; they are dropped so nx does not pick this workspace member up as a build/test target.
//dependencies: Vendored out of the upstream monorepo: the upstream `catalog:`/`workspace:*` protocols are meaningless here, so every specifier is concrete. `@mistral/monitoring` (workspace:*) is unpublished and unobtainable; its single `logger.warn` call in src/server.ts is inlined there instead. `@types/negotiator` is a dependency, not a devDependency, because this package ships raw .ts source and negotiator@1 ships no types of its own.
